# temps_ai_provider_model (Resource)

A model of a `temps_ai_provider` the gateway offers.

Import with `<provider_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `ai_gateway:read`, `ai_gateway:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_ai_provider_model" "fine_tuned" {
  provider_id = temps_ai_provider.openai.id
  model_id    = "ft:gpt-4o-mini:support"
  is_enabled  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `model_id` (String) Model name at the provider, for example `gpt-4o-mini`.
- `provider_id` (Number) ID of the AI provider.

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the console.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Offer the model through the gateway.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<provider_id>/<id>`.
- `is_available` (Boolean) Whether the provider still lists the model.
- `source` (String) `manual` or how Temps discovered the model.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <provider_id>/<id>
terraform import temps_ai_provider_model.fine_tuned 5/31
```
